reason: Out-of-time evaluation is impossible on this dataset: the snapshot-month column F2230 deterministically separates the classes. Measured from the raw file: all 9,001 negative accounts belong to the 2025-10 snapshot; all 81 positive accounts belong to the 2025-09 (48), 2025-11 (23) and 2025-12 (10) snapshots. Balanced label reconstruction from F2230 alone = 1.0. A 'train on earlier months, test on later months' split would therefore measure the label-collection artifact, not model generalisation.

evidence.disposition: F2230 quarantined (configs/leakage_quarantine.yaml); primary evaluation uses stratified locked test + repeated stratified CV at natural prevalence

note: Recorded instead of fabricating a temporal metric; see docs/LEAKAGE_AUDIT.md
